synthesis: Six retrieved records, appraised at abstract level. A comparable catch-up program raised coverage by 14 to 17 points but least in deprived schools. The regional register captures school doses well and community doses less well, so a register-based follow-up is usable with a correction, while a cluster survey with a design effect near 2.1 is a workable fallback. Deprivation and unreturned consent forms explain much of the remaining gap, and text reminders helped least where families speak other languages. One undated report could not be judged for quality.
gradeRationale: Observational before-after and cross-sectional studies, one register validation and pooled survey methods data; indirect to this district and at risk of confounding.
summary: Six retrieved records appraised; four claims recorded; overall certainty low.
